modules.name: UZZ
modules.description: Flexible 16-step sequencer for melodies and modulation, with probability, ratchets, evolving pitch, multiple playback directions and hands-on randomization.

modules.name: UZZ-X
modules.description: CV expander for UZZ, adding voltage control over sequence length, start, direction, timing, probability and pitch accumulation, plus step addressing, rotation, reset and reverse.

modules.name: ONE
modules.description: MIDI-to-CV interface for Oxi One, with pitch, gate, velocity, eight assignable controller outputs, MIDI clock and transport.

modules.name: MULTI
modules.description: Expander for ONE that turns up to eight MIDI channels into separate pitch, gate and velocity outputs.

modules.name: APC40 CTRL
modules.description: Turns the knobs and faders of an Akai APC40 into CV outputs for hands-on control of a Rack patch.

modules.name: CAP
modules.description: Stereo ducking VCA that lowers audio on each trigger and recovers with adjustable depth, timing and natural variation. It also works as a lowpass filter or a vactrol-style low-pass gate that triggers can ping. Pan with CV, a VCA CV input, envelope and end-of-cycle outputs, and CAPs placed side by side chain into a mixer without cables.

modules.name: BUS
modules.description: Mix output for a row of CAP modules placed side by side, chained without cables. Adds a stereo send and return for an insert effect, a wet control, a pan with CV, a master fader with a stereo meter, and a name that fills in with the effect patched to it.

modules.name: ADSRTEK
modules.description: ADSR and AD envelope modelled on measurements of a classic 90s virtual-analogue modular: its 128-step time table, its log, linear and exponential attacks, snappy exponential decays and its 24 kHz control rate. Retriggers pick up from the current level. Polyphonic, with CV over every stage and a built-in VCA.

modules.name: FILTERTEK
modules.description: Multimode filter modelled on measurements of a classic 90s virtual-analogue modular: lowpass, bandpass, highpass and band reject at 12 or 24 dB/oct, its resonance with gain control, and the hard fixed-point saturation that gives it its edge. Stereo and polyphonic, with a live response display, V/oct and CV over cutoff and resonance.

modules.name: UNIT-D
modules.description: Generative sequencer that turns a seeded network of points into repeatable melodies, rhythms, accents and modulation. Shape the network, let it evolve or lock a phrase you like.

modules.name: BLANK 3
modules.description: Animated 3HP blank panel with drifting Animatek logos. Adjacent Animatek blanks join into one shared canvas.

modules.name: BLANK ACID
modules.description: Animated 3HP blank panel with drifting acid smileys. Adjacent Animatek blanks join into one shared canvas.

modules.name: ATEK303
modules.description: Monophonic acid synth voice inspired by the TB-303, with oscillator, resonant filter, decay envelope, accent and slide. Every main sound control can be modulated by CV.

modules.name: ATEK303 SEQ
modules.description: Acid pattern generator of up to 64 steps for ATEK303 or any compatible synth voice. Create repeatable patterns, edit them in a piano roll, then mutate their rhythm, octave, accents and slides.
